company.shortDescription: Rune is a mobile app to play multiplayer games with friends while talking. Indie devs build Rune multiplayer games without any backend code.
company.description: Dusk is the best place to talk and play multiplayer games with your friends. Users hang out on Dusk’s mobile app, sharing laughs on our voice chat as they play indie multiplayer games together!  Developers use the Dusk SDK to build multiplayer games without needing a single line of backend code.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that allows independent developers to create multiplayer games without requiring backend coding, enabling easy deployment within the Dusk app environment.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,710,681 to $42,995,799, a 15.86x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
